author.name: Graydon Wasil
author.tagline: Software for the things I can't stop thinking about
author.bio: I build software for the things I'm already into — lyrics, records, die-cast cars, video games. I take an ordinary week's obsessions and build the tool each one was missing, then put it on the internet and keep it running. By day I'm a senior online banker, where I learned that software people trust is software that's boring in exactly the right places.
author.missionLog: LOG/2087 — OFFICER ACCESSIONS HIS OWN ARCHIVE: THE TOOLS THE HOBBIES WERE MISSING, ALL CATALOGUED.

projects.name: Rhymepage
projects.description: Write the verse, sync it to the track, run it back as a teleprompter.
projects.story: The lyric tool that didn't exist: write against the track, sync by ear, and run it back teleprompter-style. Currently being improved — it's the project that never leaves the bench.

projects.name: Collectible Cars DB
projects.description: Every Mattel Pixar Cars casting in one place: own it, want it, rate it.
projects.story: A collection that outgrew a notes app became a database for every Mattel Pixar Cars casting — own it, want it, rate it. The spreadsheet that got out of hand, fully domesticated.

projects.name: Arranged Godly
projects.description: Music, the Max for Live devices I wrote for myself, and my first finished game.
projects.story: The home shelf: my music, the Max for Live devices built because a specific delay didn't exist, and a first finished game. The origin point of the handle.

projects.name: VOXCHAIN
projects.description: Build a vocal chain, audition it live, and keep the signal under control.
projects.story: A vocal-chain builder you can audition live — stack the chain, hear it immediately, keep the signal under control. Studio discipline as a web app.

projects.name: The Experiments Shelf
projects.description: Fourteen small interactive builds, made quickly and curiously with AI-assisted tools.
projects.story: Thread Art, Biome Generator, Loom, Traffic, Terrarium, Blind Test, How Votes Flow, The Disappearing Draft, Reading Pacer, bc-codes, The Register, the Interlocking Gear Animator, the Digital Harmonograph, and a Message Board — a shelf of quick, curious builds. Thread Art (an image become a field of woven thread) is the highlighted specimen.
